pipeline.title: Roche’s Gazyva secures FDA nod for idiopathic nephrotic syndrome, extending autoimmune pivot
pipeline.summary: Roche’s Gazyva just increased its foothold in the autoimmune market with a fresh FDA approval, becoming the first new treatment option in 70 years for patients with idiopathic nephrotic syndrome.

pipeline.title: Kodiak skyrockets on positive study data for 2 eye drugs
pipeline.summary: The Phase 3 findings suggested Kodiak might have multiple threats to Regeneron’s Eylea and added more than $3 billion to the company’s market value.

pipeline.title: Roche drops muscle-sparing obesity antibody after flunked interim analysis
pipeline.summary: Roche has slammed the brakes on an obesity antibody after the candidate showed little hope of hitting its endpoints in a phase 2 study.

pipeline.title: Mirum posts phase 3 hepatitis win for ‘commercially differentiated’ challenger to Gilead, Vir
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 trial of Mirum Pharmaceuticals’ chronic hepatitis delta virus drug candidate has hit its primary endpoint, furthering the biotech’s efforts to enter a space recently colonized by Gilead Sciences.

pipeline.title: Kodiak's stock doubles as resurrected eye disease drug matches Eylea in phase 3
pipeline.summary: Two of Kodiak Sciences’ drug candidates have matched aflibercept in a phase 3 clinical trial, positioning the biotech to seek FDA approval of one of the eye disease assets this year.

pipeline.title: Merck, Daiichi pull lung cancer filing after FDA pushback deals another blow to $4B deal
pipeline.summary: Daiichi Sankyo and Merck & Co. have withdrawn an antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) filing after the FDA said they lacked the data for accelerated approval in a lung cancer population.

pipeline.title: Merck, Eisai’s Welireg-Lenvima combo lands FDA nod to jump the kidney cancer queue
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. has scored an FDA approval for its blockbuster-to-be Welireg to move into second-line treatment of kidney cancer, where analysts have projected a rapid uptake.

pipeline.title: Elevar wins FDA nod for bile duct cancer drug Lyrfigtu, a first for a Korean firm
pipeline.summary: The FDA has green-lighted Elevar’s FGFR2-selective inhibitor Lyrfigtu in bile duct cancer, making it the first novel cancer drug from a Korean company to secure FDA approval.

pipeline.title: Acadia misses mark in Alzheimer’s but concludes phase 3 ‘absolutely worth’ pursuing
pipeline.summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals’ phase 2 Alzheimer’s disease trial has missed its primary endpoint, but the company and analysts alike saw enough encouraging signals to support the continuation of a phase 3 program.

pipeline.title: Merck sees pivotal victory for $3B eye disease prospect
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co.’s Brunello trial has hit its primary endpoint, shedding light on the effects of a trispecific diabetic macular edema (DME) drug candidate that the Big Pharma bought in a $3 billion takeover.

pipeline.title: Mirum bags FDA approval for ultra-rare bone lesion disorder, heating up rivalry with Regeneron
pipeline.summary: Mirum's Atebrioz gained FDA approval for FOP on the heels of Regeneron's green light in the same indication last month.

pipeline.title: An ‘off-the-shelf’ CAR-T therapy from Adicet shows promise against lupus
pipeline.summary: Data from an early trial showed the company’s “gamma delta” cell therapy surpassed benchmarks set by personalized CAR-T treatments tested in lupus.

pipeline.title: BioNTech to close 3 sites in Germany after failed buyer search
pipeline.summary: BioNTech is set to shutter several sites in Germany, impacting about 1,800 jobs, after efforts to find buyers fell through.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly's new initiative will take GLP-1s to lower-income nations
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly aims to see its diabetes and obesity medications treat as many patients in low- and middle-income countries as it does in high income countries.

pipeline.title: Scynexis bags $214M BARDA contract for antifungal development
pipeline.summary: The Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA) has awarded Scynexis a $214 million contract for the development of a treatment for invasive fungal infections.

pipeline.title: Tolerance continues thymus-focused deals with $560M pact for Tanabe's clinical-stage IL-33 drug
pipeline.summary: After vaulting into the clinic by licensing a fusion protein last month, Tolerance Bio has continued to strengthen its thymus-focused pipeline by picking up an anti-IL-33 drug from Tanabe Pharma.

pipeline.title: Merck, Daiichi end plans to seek speedy approval of lung cancer ADC
